- Navigation system: MBUX
- 13 Speakers

- Panoramic Sunroof
- Power Liftgate
- Exclusive Nappa Leather Upholstery

With a city fuel efficiency of 15 MPG and a highway rating of 19 MPG, this SUV strikes the perfect balance between power and efficiency.

Stepping inside, you'll be greeted by a cabin that exudes sophistication and attention to detail. The Nappa Leather upholstery, genuine wood accents, and premium MBUX infotainment system create an environment that is both luxurious and technologically advanced. The heated and ventilated power front seats with driver memory ensure exceptional comfort, while the panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light, enhancing the overall ambiance.

Safety and driver assistance features are also at the forefront of this GLE 63 S AMG® 4MATIC®. From the advanced airbag system and electronic stability control to the rear-view camera and automatic high-beam headlights, you can drive with confidence knowing that you and your passengers are well-protected.

This 2022 Mercedes-Benz GLE GLE 63 S AMG® 4MATIC® is a true masterpiece of engineering and design. With its unparalleled performance, exceptional luxury, and comprehensive suite of features, it is the perfect choice for the discerning buyer who demands the very best. We invite you to experience the power and refinement of this remarkable SUV firsthand. Contact us today to schedule a test drive and discover the true meaning of automotive excellence.

Volvo Cars Lisle is proud to present this stunning CARFAX One-Owner 2026 Volvo XC90 T8 Plus. Finished in the timeless and commanding Onyx Black Metallic, this flagship SUV represents the pinnacle of Volvo's "Recharge" electrificationcombining supercar-level performance with a serene, electric-only driving mode. As a Certified by Volvo vehicle, it features a factory-backed 5-Year/Unlimited-Mile Warranty, offering you the confidence of a new car with exceptional pre-owned value.

T8 Plug-In Hybrid Performance
The T8 Recharge powertrain is Volvos most advanced engine, delivering exhilarating power and standard-setting efficiency:

Massive Output: The 2.0L Turbocharged Hybrid engine delivers a staggering 455 hp and 500 lb-ft of torque.

eAWD (Electric All-Wheel Drive): The rear wheels are powered by a high-output electric motor, providing instantaneous traction and a smooth, rear-biased AWD experience for Chicagoland winters.

Pure Electric Range: Commute to work or run local errands on 100% electricity, with the gas engine always ready for long-distance luxury.

21" Diamond Cut Alloys: This XC90 makes a bold statement on 21" 5-Multi Spoke Black Diamond Cut Alloy wheels.

6-Passenger Luxury & Elite Sound
The "Plus" trim with the 6-passenger configuration provides a first-class experience for every occupant:

Captain's Chairs: The 6-passenger layout features a walk-through center aisle, providing easier access to the third row and more shoulder room for second-row passengers.

Harman Kardon Premium Sound: A high-fidelity audio system designed specifically for the XC90's cabin acoustics to provide an immersive listening experience.

Nordico Upholstery: A contemporary, sustainable, and highly durable material that offers a premium leather-like feel with a significantly lower environmental footprint.

Panoramic Moonroof: A full-length glass roof that floods all three rows with natural light at the touch of a button.

Family Safety & Winter Readiness
Climate Package: Purpose-built for the Midwest with a Heated Steering Wheel, Heated Front Seats, and Heated Rear Seats.

Pilot Assist: Volvos advanced semi-autonomous driving system with Adaptive Cruise Control and Lane Keeping Aid for effortless travel on I-88 and I-355.

Integrated Rear Child Seat: A signature Volvo safety featurethe second row includes a built-in booster cushion to ensure younger passengers travel with maximum security.

Headlight Cleaning: Ensures your LED headlights stay clear of snow and road salt for maximum visibility.

Volvo Certified Pre-Owned Benefits
This XC90 T8 Plus qualifies for the industry-leading Certified by Volvo program:

5-Year/Unlimited-Mileage Warranty (from original in-service date).

$0 Deductible for all covered repairs.

170+ Point Rigorous Inspection by factory-trained technicians.

24/7/365 Roadside Assistance.

1-Year Complimentary Volvo Cars App for remote start and climate pre-conditioning.

The DriveSure Advantage Only at Volvo Cars Lisle
This vehicle qualifies for our exclusive DriveSure program. When you maintain your XC90 at Volvo Cars Lisle, your Roadside Assistance, Road Hazard Tire Protection, and Alternate Transportation benefits automatically renewa level of commitment to your journey that makes us "A Dealer You Can Trust."

Experience the Future of Flagship Luxury
Discover the power and silence of the 2026 Volvo XC90 T8 at Volvo Cars Lisle, conveniently located near Naperville, Downers Grove, and Glen Ellyn.

Convenience
  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
  • Power open and close liftgate - On-demand access. When your arms are full of cargo, the last thing you want to do is set it all down just to open the liftgate, then pick it all back up to load it in. By remotely opening and closing, power liftgate lets you skip straight to the loading. It also eliminates the awkward stretch to reach up for the liftgate to close it. Load and go with power open and close liftgate.
Safety and Security
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
  • Selective Internet access - a more focused delivery. Selective internet access allows you to tailor the features for your feed, such as sports scores, local news, or current weather. When it comes to getting what you want, selective internet access is a net gain.

Initially created by AM General and produced in civilian form by General Motors, the Hummer nameplate stands for military-inspired, go-anywhere ability. The latest iteration lives up to that name, with the GMC Hummer EV incorporating the same boxy aesthetic of its forebears while continuing to focus heavily on off-road ability. Our featured vehicle is finished in Void Black, a color that complements the boxy dimensions, squat stance, and new-age styling of the 2024 GMC Hummer EV3X SUV. GMC has also developed some incredible new features for the EV reincarnation of the Hummer, including four-wheel steering with “Crab Walk,” while enabling even greater mobility off-road. Panoramic Vista Roof: A massive dual-pane glass roof that spans the first two rows, flooding the cabin with natural light.

The Covert Commitment

The 2023 MercedesBenz GLC 43 AMG 4MATIC arrives with the kind of presence that feels effortlesslike it already knows youll want to look twice. Its not trying to be a loud spectacle. Instead, it carries itself with a quietly assertive posture: a sleek, athletic silhouette, purposeful lines that flow from front to rear like a confident stride, and design cues that hint at performance without turning everyday practicality into a costume. From a distance, it reads as premium. Up close, it feels intentionaleach surface shaped to look poised, each detail placed to suggest refinement with a pulse.

This is a crossover for people who dont want to compromise on style or spirit. The GLC 43 has that AMG energy in its visual languagean attitude that feels sporty, but never chaotic. It looks planted and ready, the kind of vehicle that makes parking lot moments feel like arrivals. Even sitting still, it seems to be waiting for the light to change, as if motion is part of its personality rather than something it only does on command.

Step inside and the atmosphere gets even better. The cabin feels wrapped in comfort and craftsmanship, where premium materials meet a driver-focused layout that says, Youre here to enjoy the drive. The seating feels supportive in a way that encourages you to settle in and stay awhile. The controls have that satisfying, everything has a place feelnothing feels random or overly busy. Its not just luxury for luxurys sake, its a refined environment designed to keep you confident and connected, whether youre heading to a meeting or escaping onto a curving road.

Then theres the way the GLC 43 AMG performs in daily lifeexciting, but not exhausting. It has the kind of responsiveness that makes you grin when the road opens up, yet remains composed and civilized when youre simply moving through real schedules. Around town, it feels eager to adjust to your pace. On the highway, it feels stable and confident, like its comfortable taking charge of the long way home. The ride doesnt lose its manners, either, it stays polished, translating imperfections into manageable moments rather than turning every bump into a conversation you didnt ask to have.

What really defines the GLC 43, though, is its balance. Its sporty enough to feel like an event, but practical enough to be your daily. Its a crossover that can carry passengers without turning into a chore, and it delivers a driving feel that makes errands feel less like obligations and more like opportunities.

In short, the 2023 MercedesBenz GLC 43 AMG 4MATIC is a stylish performance SUV in the best sense of the phrase: elegant, confident, and just a little bit mischievous. It doesnt just get you thereit makes the journey feel sharper, richer, and more rewarding than you expected.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. For those requiring additional utility, the Class IV Trailer Tow Package makes this Aviator as capable as it is luxurious. The power liftgate provides convenient access to ample cargo space, while the third-row seating offers flexibility for passengers and storage.

Equipped with a state-of-the-art 2.5L I4 PDI Hybrid DOHC 16V LEV3-SULEV30 engine and an eCVT transmission, this Highlander Hybrid delivers an impressive 35 city/34 highway MPG, making it the perfect companion for your daily commute and weekend adventures. The Four-Wheel Disc Brakes with ABS and Electronic Stability Control further enhance your confidence behind the wheel.

Porsche Marin is proud to present this exceptional 2023 Porsche Macan, a luxury compact SUV that perfectly blends everyday practicality with the unmistakable driving dynamics and refinement Porsche is known for. Finished in elegant Volcano Grey Metallic over a Black interior, this Macan is beautifully equipped with premium features and a sophisticated specification.
Powered by a responsive turbocharged engine paired with Porsches renowned 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK) transmission, the Macan delivers smooth acceleration, agile handling, and a confident driving experience. Engineered with precision and balance, it offers the versatility of an SUV while maintaining the sporty character expected from Porsche.
This example is exceptionally well-appointed with the Premium Package Plus, adding a host of comfort and convenience features designed to elevate every drive. The exterior is enhanced by LED Headlights with Porsche Dynamic Light System Plus (PDLS+), striking 20-inch Macan S wheels finished in Highly Polished Dark Titanium, and the panoramic roof system, creating a modern and refined presence on the road.
Inside, the cabin offers a clean and driver-focused design with premium materials throughout. Comfort features include 14-way power seats with memory package, ventilated front seats, heated rear seats, and an expansive panoramic roof that brings additional openness to the interior. The standout Burmester High-End Surround Sound System delivers an exceptional audio experience, providing concert-quality sound for every journey.
Technology and safety are seamlessly integrated with features such as Lane Change Assist (LCA), advanced lighting systems, and intuitive connectivity, ensuring both convenience and confidence behind the wheel.
With its elegant color combination, extensive factory options, and signature Porsche driving dynamics, this 2023 Porsche Macan represents an outstanding opportunity to own one of the most refined and capable luxury SUVs in its class.
For more information or to schedule a private viewing, please contact lcouncil@porschemarin.com or visit us in person.
